verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own sensitive-data-management tools that let customers redact or remove data retroactively for GDPR, CCPA and HIPAA compliance, which covers deletion. It also offers an on-premise edition for organizations that want to manage their own data. Retention control itself is not evidenced: no configurable retention periods or automatic expiry are documented, and event-quota and discard rules only govern what is ingested, not how long stored data is kept. Missing for 10: configurable data-retention periods or automatic expiry, programmatic or API-driven deletion, documented depth of the deletion tools, independent corroboration.
